description: This source file implements a command-line program for generating files used in crash cache unit tests for the Chromium project. It includes functions to create, manipulate, and simulate cache operations, and manages subprocesses to perform crash scenarios, primarily for testing cache recovery and crash handling in debug mode.

methods.name: RunSlave
methods.description: Starts a subprocess to perform specific cache crash test actions based on the provided RankCrashes enum value.

methods.name: MasterCode
methods.description: Main loop that runs multiple crash test scenarios by spawning subprocesses.

methods.name: CreateTargetFolder
methods.description: Creates a specific directory for a crash test scenario based on the action.

methods.name: FlushQueue
methods.description: Ensures all pending cache operations are completed.

methods.name: CreateCache
methods.description: Initializes a cache instance in a separate thread with specified size and flags.

methods.name: SimpleInsert
methods.description: Creates a cache with a single entry, used for crash testing insert scenarios.

methods.name: SimpleRemove
methods.description: Creates a cache, adds an entry, then removes it, simulating removal crash scenarios.

methods.name: HeadRemove
methods.description: Creates a cache, adds entries, then removes the head entry, for testing head removal crashes.

methods.name: LoadOperations
methods.description: Performs multiple cache insertions and deletions to simulate heavy load crash scenarios.

methods.name: SlaveCode
methods.description: Main function for the subprocess that executes specific cache operations based on the action.
